title: Viscosity and Density of Aqueous Solutions of Carbon Dioxide at Temperatures from (274 to 449) K and at Pressures up to 100 MPa

experimental_method: Vibrating U-tube densimeter (density) and vibrating-wire viscometer (viscosity), separate experiments, single-phase compressed liquid CO2-water solutions at x = 0.0086, 0.0168, 0.0271.

quality_remarks: Ranges match abstract: density T 274-449 K, p 15-100.8 MPa; viscosity T 294-449 K, p 15-96.5 MPa. Pressure reported without an absolute/gauge statement. Temperatures of a printed T block differ slightly between x blocks (e.g. 274.73 K vs 274.77 K), as printed. Not every T,p combination measured at each x (single-phase requirement). Table 7 pressures have one decimal, Table 5 two; some viscosities have 4 decimals (0.2932 etc.) as printed. Temperature scale: PRTs calibrated against a standard PRT calibrated on ITS-90.
extraction_notes: Side-by-side (p, value) column pairs stacked with a label row per x block and per T sub-block; empty ragged cells not written. Headers transliterated: 'rho kg m-3', 'eta mPa s'.
